judgment.reason: From p16, at least one of (Ada wears a ivory hat) or (Ada wears a ivory badge) is true. If Ada wears a ivory hat, then by p18, Ada wears a scarlet ribbon. If Ada wears a ivory badge, then by p6, Ada wears a scarlet ribbon. Either way, Ada wears a scarlet ribbon. By p4, if Ada wears a scarlet ribbon, then Ada wears a ivory coat. Therefore, Ada wears a ivory coat is TRUE, making the negation (the query) FALSE.
